sections.title: Set off of losses under any other head of income.

subsections.text_before_clauses: Subject to the provisions of this Chapter, for any tax year, if income computed under any head of income (other than "Capital gains") is a loss, such loss shall be set off against income of the assessee under any other head, including "Capital gains", if any, assessable for that tax year, subject to the following conditions:—

clauses.text: loss under the head "Profits and gains of business or profession" shall not be set off against income assessable under the head "Salaries"; and
loss under the head "Income from house property" shall be set off to the extent of Rs. 200000 against income under any other head.

subsections.text: For any tax year, the loss under the head "Capital gains" shall not be set off against income under any other head.
